transcript:
Meeting header:
Date: 2027-05-10 10:00 PDT
Duration: ~62 minutes
Attendees: Aria Morgan, Devon Park, Ravi Kapoor, Lena Ortiz, Samira Patel, Jordan Lee, Maya Cortez, Ethan Wu + many others (all-hands)

Summary (auto): Leadership update on Q1, product roadmap highlights, operations and security updates, hiring and org notes.

00:00 Aria Morgan: Hey everyone, thanks for joining on time. we've got a pretty full agenda today, so we'll run maybe 50, 60 minutes and leave time for q and a at the end. quick housekeeping: recording is on, and please keep mic muted unless you're speaking.
00:18 Aria Morgan: Quick wins to start — revenue is up month over month, we've crossed the thousand active developer mark for our hosted API, which is, uh, really solid. shout out to the sales and devrel teams.
00:33 Jordan Lee: Yeah team did great — dedicated signings this quarter were two mid-market health customers and an e-comm platform that will go live in June.
00:46 Devon Park: On the engineering side the big thing is latency and cost improvements — our new quantized kernels and batching changes reduced average per-token cost by about 22% on the workloads we measured, and median p99 latency is down 18% across our hosted fleet. there are still outliers, though, especially on long-context customers.
01:10 Ravi Kapoor: To add, the runtime changes also improved GPU utilization; continuous batching got less jitter. Our Dedicated customers are seeing more predictable throughput. we'll publish the benchmark spreadsheet next week.
01:25 Lena Ortiz: Product updates: Optimize is getting model-aware recommendations — so it will suggest quantization profiles, batching size, and caching TTLs based on traffic patterns. Early pilot customers have seen cost drops without quality regressions.
01:41 Samira Patel: We've also added a new canary rollout option in Console: you can do per-route model pinning and automated rollback on quality regressions. It hooks into the evals framework.
01:58 Aria Morgan: Nice. quick note on Private — we've got a few late-stage prospects asking for on-prem options and HSM/KMS integrations; the on-prem build is in final internal testing.
02:12 Ethan Wu: On the ops front, SRE ran a stability run last week. p95 tail latency improved but we also spotted a retry storm on a customer with aggressive batching — working that with customer success.
02:33 Aria Morgan: Security and compliance?
02:36 Ethan Wu: SOC 2 recert is on the calendar for Q3 prep; we'll start a cross-team checklist next week. also working on better audit log retention options for Private customers.
02:50 Maya Cortez: People — we hired 12 engineers this quarter, ramp is on track. compensation cycle in June — managers, please prep calibration notes. and two leadership hires closing this month.
03:05 Aria Morgan: High-level roadmap items for next quarter: APAC region rollout, GA for Private on our VPC package, and a set of reliability SLOs for Dedicated.
03:20 (muted) crowd noise/overlap
03:42 Q&A / Notes from audience: several live questions queued in chat.
04:05 Audience Q (Slack question read by Lina): Any timeline for APAC?
04:12 Devon Park: We're targeting late July for APAC soft launch; first region will be Singapore with a minimal DDoS and networking handshake. the plan depends on partner infra and capacity.
04:31 Audience Q (voice): How will pricing be affected for Dedicated versus hosted after Optimize?
04:37 Jordan Lee: We don't plan list price changes, Optimize is a toolkit to reduce customers' unit costs by recommendations; Dedicated pricing stays the same but customers can reduce ops costs via config and caching. we'll provide a sample ROI calc.
04:58 Audience Q (voice): Any risks with quantization on quality?
05:05 Samira Patel: Good question — quantization profiles are model and workload specific. our evals harness runs diff checks on prompt sets before we promote profiles. we saw minimal quality deltas on customer sets in pilot, but we hold canaries and rollback windows.
05:26 Audience Q (voice): SOC 2 — what changes to expect?
05:32 Ethan Wu: Mostly maturity work: formalize runbooks, complete a couple of overdue infra docs, tighten key rotation procedures. customers asking about encryption at rest with HSM — that's on the Private roadmap.
05:50 Aria Morgan: Ok let's call out wins and risks. wins: pipeline strength, product features shipping, engineering perf wins. risks: capacity for APAC, handling long-context latency, and SOC2 prep bandwidth.
06:10 Ravi Kapoor: On the capacity front we plan to move some Dedicated backfill traffic to partner capacity during peak APAC launch to avoid impacting hosted customers. it's a routing policy change.
06:28 Lena Ortiz: For product we want to make canary rollouts first-class — docs and example configs will go into the Console docs. we'll also bundle a canary eval template into the evals repo.
06:46 Aria Morgan: Ok let's go into some specifics — Ravi, can you talk about the quantization rollout timeline?
06:52 Ravi Kapoor: Sure — internal rollout week after next, public docs the week after that. objective is to onboard top 10 customers into pilot in June, then broad rollout by end of Q3. I'll put the spreadsheet in the shared drive with benchmarks.
07:15 Aria Morgan: Great. Devrel — we need a public facing benchmark page patched with the latest numbers. keep it clear on workloads and caveats.
07:24 Jordan Lee: On sales, a reminder: if you're pushing Dedicated or Private, flag compliance needs early — we lost a deal last quarter because we surfaced SOC2 late in the process.
07:38 Audience (murmur): yeah
07:50 (short pause)
08:05 Audience Q (voice): For customers on long context, any roadmap for KV cache improvements?
08:12 Samira Patel: KV cache management work is ongoing — better prefetch heuristics and eviction policies. we also have an experimental hybrid cache for on-host prewarm. it's pretty promising but not GA.
08:33 Audience Q (typed): Will the new canary option appear in the SDK or just the Console?
08:40 Lena Ortiz: Both — Console for ops folks, SDK for programmatic rollouts. examples will be in the repo.
08:51 Aria Morgan: Ops to run DR drill for Dedicated clusters — Ethan, can you lead?
08:56 Ethan Wu: Yep, scheduling for end of May, we'll share the date.
09:05 Aria Morgan: People update, Maya?
09:08 Maya Cortez: Assuming recruiting continues at current velocity, next quarter focus is senior platform engineers and security folks. interview panel training next week. also, I'll send managers guidance on comp cycle.
09:22 Audience applause (virtual)
09:30 Aria Morgan: Okay final bit: FYI on partner ecosystem — we signed two new infra partners for capacity burst, helps APAC. marketing will prep comms.
09:42 Jordan Lee: Also, finance note — we extended a line for Dedicated capacity procurement which gives us some runway for pre-provisioning hardware.
09:55 Audience Q (voice): Any update on integrations with customer KMS/HSM?
10:03 Ethan Wu: HSM integration roadmap is Q3; Private customers can opt into KMS today but HSM is gated by some legal and infra testing.
10:18 Audience Q (voice): How do we avoid regression when we push quantized kernels?
10:23 Samira Patel: We run canaries that compare model outputs on a sample prompt set and have automated threshold checks. if the divergence exceeds the threshold we rollback. also have human-in-the-loop for high-risk customers.
10:43 (crosstalk)
11:00 Aria Morgan: Ok that's the end of prepared remarks. open q and a for the next 45 minutes — we'll take both chat and mic questions.
11:10 Audience Q (mic): Is there a short checklist for sales to qualify Dedicated deals faster?
11:18 Jordan Lee: Yes — short checklist will land in the sales wiki, includes security requirements, expected traffic patterns, PII/data residency needs. I'll ask CS to add a template.
11:35 Audience Q (typed): Can we see the ROI example for Optimize?
11:40 Lena Ortiz: We'll publish an ROI calc with assumptions and links to sample configs. that goes up next week.
11:58 (some small side discussions, people dropping)
12:15 Aria Morgan: Thanks everyone — recap: Ravi to share rollout plan, Lena docs, Security checklist, People Ops hiring notes. we'll follow up in slack channels and the all-hands recap doc. meeting adjourned.

[End of transcript — automated timestamps approximate, transcription contains informal speech patterns and occasional misattributions.]
